subject: 20260620-hosted-api-pricing-qualification
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: alex.martinez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + quick ask on volumes/budget (Hosted API)

Thanks again for taking the call today, Jordan - good to meet you and Sam. Quick recap from my side and one ask so we can put together an accurate hosted-API Cost Estimate:

Call highlights:
- Use case: conversational search + personalization in Acme's mobile app (mix of short prompts + multi-turn chat).
- Quality target: comparable to open Llama-2/Redwood-verified medium models for retrieval + 1-2 hard-shot prompts routed to higher-capacity model.
- SLO: 200-300ms p50 for chat flows, tolerance for higher p95 during launches.

One ask (actionable): could you confirm expected monthly token volume and expected peak TPS for the integration? A couple useful buckets:
- Expected steady-state tokens / month (first 3 months)
- Expected ramp to steady-state (months to reach)
- Peak TPS during marketing/launch spikes
- Any target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range you need us to hit for procurement

If you can drop rough numbers today/tomorrow I'll run a hosted-API unit-econ estimate and share a one-page cost summary + our recommended config (batching, KV cache, and whether Dedicated makes sense).

Next steps from Redwood (pending your numbers):
- Cost estimate (hosted API) + options for committed/discounted tiers
- Sharing a 1-page hosted pricing PDF and a mutual action plan (attached)
- Schedule a short follow-up to walk the numbers (30 min)

Attachments: Redwood_Hosted_Pricing_Overview.pdf (overview), Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

Thanks - talk soon.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
https://redwood.com/

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + quick ask on volumes/budget (Hosted API)

Thanks Marissa - great call. Quick answers below (rough estimates, happy to refine):

- Steady-state tokens / month (first 3 months): ~75M tokens (we're piloting with ~10k MAU).
- Ramp: expect to reach ~200M tokens/month within 6-9 months if pilot converts to paid users.
- Peak TPS: baseline ~2 TPS, launch spikes up to ~12 TPS (short bursts, 10-15 minutes) - our traffic is spiky with seasonal promos.
- Budget target: initial pilot budget $3k- $5k/month; procurement target for next FY would be $6k- $12k/month depending on unit economics.
- Target unit-economics: we'd like to get under ~$20 / 1M tokens ideally, but we can be flexible if higher-tier features or latency SLAs require it.

Cc'ed Sam (product) - Sam, flag any additional constraints (privacy, retention) we should include in the estimate.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Senior Product Manager | Acme Retail
jordan.lee@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: alex.martinez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + quick ask on volumes/budget (Hosted API)

Jordan - perfect, this is exactly what I need. I ran a quick hosted-API sketch based on the 3 scenarios you mentioned and attached the one-page pricing overview + a mutual action plan. High-level notes below:

Scenario A - Pilot (75M tokens/month)
- Assumptions: baseline batching, default caching, hosted API (no reserved capacity)
- Estimated list cost: ~$1,500- $3,000 / month (depends on model mix and prompt length)

Scenario B - Ramp (200M tokens/month)
- Assumptions: batching/kv cache tuning, commit discount possible for 6-12 month reserved capacity
- Estimated list cost: ~$4,000- $8,000 / month; with a 20-30% commit discount we'd target ~$3,000- $5,500 / month

Peak TPS note: with ~12 TPS spikes we recommend staying on hosted for pilot; if spikes are frequent and sustained we'd evaluate Dedicated pools (predictable throughput + lower per-token unit cost at scale).

Unit economics: I captured your target ~$20 / 1M tokens. For comparison, our hosted list rates (depending on model) generally sit in tiers - I left ranges in the attached PDF so procurement can see the tradeoffs. If $/1M target is a must-have, a committed discount or Dedicated capacity is usually the lever to get there.

Next steps:
- I'll drop a short 30-min cost-walkthrough next week (available Mon/Tue). What day works?
- If you want a formal quote for procurement we can put together a 1-page quote + optional commitment tiers (I’ll need an expected 3-12 month volume commitment).

Attachments: Redwood_Hosted_Pricing_Overview.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
